text:
Type: industrial dark grey pendant lamp
Use: directed light over a dining table, a bar or a kitchen island; kitchen, dining room, living room
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: powder-coated steel shade with a matte finish, black cord woven through a metal chain, round steel ceiling plate
Colors: dark grey, charcoal black
Shape: deep bell shade with a cylindrical top and a flared lower rim, suspended from a link chain, solid and graphic, medium visual weight
Feel: rugged, urban, strong, moody
Goes with: concrete floors, dark wood, black metal, exposed brick; industrial or modern kitchens and lofts

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 600 lumen. View more product information This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
